recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic portrait of a man with a high-top fade haircut, wearing an open white blazer against a draped fabric background. The composition features a dominant vertical condensed title in the upper right, anchored by a geometric diamond shape.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's downward gaze creates a diagonal line leading from the top left to the center right.
The stark white of the blazer contrasts sharply with the deep shadows of the subject's skin and the dark typography.
The verticality of the main title mirrors the elongated proportions of the subject's hairstyle and facial structure.
coreInvariants: High-contrast studio lighting with soft shadows
Draped fabric background providing textural depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-left, medium shot, slightly angled downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, condensed title block in the upper right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the high-top fade, follows the gaze down to the hand on the chest, then moves up to the bold typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space provided by the blazer and background drapes to balance the dark skin tones and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with slight tapering at terminals
Horizontal bars integrated into a diamond-shaped container for secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'H' and 'E' have extremely short horizontal strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-condensed display type and wide, extended secondary sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal diamond/lozenge shape containing secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme vertical compression and bold presence.
Provides the necessary weight and blocky feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic, purple-tinted studio portrait of a man with a 90s high-top fade, wearing an open white blazer, looking down, against draped white fabric.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed, vertically elongated sans-serif text in the top right corner. Include a secondary line of text inside a dark diamond-shaped graphic element below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic?

adjustableVariables: Tint of the monochrome (e.g., blue-gray vs. purple-gray)
Degree of vertical stretch in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Smooth gradients in the skin tones

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the monochromatic consistency across all elements
Confirm the geometric diamond element is centered under the primary text
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + ultra-condensed display type + geometric accent shape = 90s urban editorial aesthetic.
